lines.text: The water stayed dark. Good. The cell will move the scouts away.
You lit it. Something saw the light. The cell does not forgive that easily.
One more thing. The cell keeps an evidence cylinder for you. Trafficking records. Do you want them?

choice.text: Give them to the Terrarium Authority. In writing.
Keep them. I do not want to hold what I cannot protect.

lines.text: Authority. In writing. Fine. The cell is going to hate you for this. Slightly.
Respectful. Annoying. The cell holds it.
